name: manual_b7d5e4
claim: Cascade grant IDs supplied by an issuer identify issuer-authoritatively affected dependent grants only; they must not assert consumer execution or consumption state, and consumer dispatch gating must remain local.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20 E1 C2 review: wording that grants were unconsumed at cascade commit implied issuer knowledge of consumer execution. The repaired schema limits issuer claims to its own authority while retaining notification, audit, and recovery value.

rationale: 2026-10-20 E1 C2 review: wording that grants were unconsumed at cascade commit implied issuer knowledge of consumer execution. The repaired schema limits issuer claims to its own authority while retaining notification, audit, and recovery value.
